fn step(bal: Int, x: Int) -> Int
  requires (bal >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result == (bal + x)) or (((result == bal) and (x < 0)) and ((bal + x) < 0)))
  effects pure
  example (step(10, 5) == 15)
  example (step(3, -5) == 3)
  example (step(5, -3) == 2)
  example (step(0, 0) == 0)
{
  if (x >= 0) then (bal + x) else if ((bal + x) >= 0) then (bal + x) else bal
}

fn run_from(xs: List[Int], bal: Int) -> Int
  requires (bal >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((len(xs) != 0) or (result == bal))
  effects pure
  example (run_from([], 4) == 4)
  example (run_from([10, -3, -20, 5], 0) == 12)
  example (run_from([-5, 2], 0) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => bal [h, ..t] => run_from(t, step(bal, h)) }
}

fn balance(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((len(xs) != 0) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (balance([10, -3, -20, 5]) == 12)
  example (balance([-5, 2]) == 2)
  example (balance([]) == 0)
{
  run_from(xs, 0)
}

fn keep_evens(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  ensures forall x in result: ((x % 2) == 0)
  ensures forall x in xs: (((x % 2) != 0) or (count(result, x) == count(xs, x)))
  effects pure
  example (keep_evens([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [2, 4])
  example (keep_evens([5, 7]) == [])
  example (keep_evens([]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) == 0) then ([h] ++ keep_evens(t)) else keep_evens(t) }
}

  effects pure
  example (keep_odds([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 3])
  example (keep_odds([5, 7]) == [5, 7])
  example (keep_odds([]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if ((h % 2) != 0) then ([h] ++ keep_odds(t)) else keep_odds(t) }
}

fn evens_first(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)

  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == count(xs, x))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (((result[i] % 2) == 0) or (forall j in i..len(result): ((result[j] % 2) != 0)))
  effects pure
  example (evens_first([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [2, 4, 1, 3])
  example (evens_first([5, 7]) == [5, 7])
  example (evens_first([]) == [])
{
  (keep_evens(xs) ++ keep_odds(xs))
}

  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (lo >= 0)
  requires (lo < hi)
  requires ((lo * lo) <= n)
  requires ((hi * hi) > n)

  effects pure

}

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (2 * len(xs)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((result[(2 * i)] == xs[i]) and (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [y, ..u] => ([h, y] ++ interleave(t, u)) } }
}

fn le_all(h: Int, xs: List[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result or (exists x in xs: (h > x)))
  ensures ((not result) or (forall x in xs: (h <= x)))
  effects pure
  example (le_all(1, [2, 3]) == true)
  example (le_all(2, [1]) == false)
  example (le_all(0, []) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => true [x, ..t] => ((h <= x) and le_all(h, t)) }
}

fn is_sorted(xs: List[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == sorted(xs))
  effects pure
  example (is_sorted([1, 2, 2, 5]) == true)
  example (is_sorted([3, 1]) == false)
  example (is_sorted([]) == true)
{
  match xs { [] => true [h, ..t] => (le_all(h, t) and is_sorted(t)) }
}

fn size(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (size([7, 2, 9, 4]) == 4)
  example (size([]) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + size(t)) }
}

fn filter_lt(xs: List[Int], p: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures forall x in result: (x < p)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x >= p) or contains(result, x))
  ensures distinct(result)
  effects pure
  example (filter_lt([7, 2, 9, 4], 5) == [2, 4])
  example (filter_lt([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == [])
  example (filter_lt([], 3) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h < p) then ([h] ++ filter_lt(t, p)) else filter_lt(t, p) }
}

fn filter_gt(xs: List[Int], p: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures forall x in result: (x > p)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x <= p) or contains(result, x))
  ensures distinct(result)
  ensures (((len(result) + len(filter_lt(xs, p))) + count(xs, p)) == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (filter_gt([7, 2, 9, 4], 5) == [7, 9])
  example (filter_gt([7, 2, 9, 4], 9) == [])
  example (filter_gt([], 3) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h > p) then ([h] ++ filter_gt(t, p)) else filter_gt(t, p) }
}

fn kth_smallest(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires (k >= 1)
  requires (k <= len(xs))
  ensures (contains(xs, result) and (len(filter_lt(xs, result)) == (k - 1)))
  effects pure
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == 4)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (kth_smallest([5], 1) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [p, ..t] => if (size(filter_lt(xs, p)) == (k - 1)) then p else if ((k - 1) < size(filter_lt(xs, p))) then kth_smallest(filter_lt(xs, p), k) else kth_smallest(filter_gt(xs, p), ((k - size(filter_lt(xs, p))) - 1)) }
}

  ensures forall x in result: (x > p)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x <= p) or contains(result, x))
  ensures distinct(result)
  ensures (((len(result) + len(filter_lt(xs, p))) + count(xs, p)) == len(xs))

fn min_acc(best: Int, xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result <= best)
  ensures forall x in xs: (result <= x)
  ensures (contains(xs, result) or (result == best))
  effects pure
  example (min_acc(5, [3, 7]) == 3)
  example (min_acc(1, [3, 7]) == 1)
  example (min_acc(9, []) == 9)
{
  match xs { [] => best [h, ..t] => if (h < best) then min_acc(h, t) else min_acc(best, t) }
}

fn min_val(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (result <= x)
  effects pure
  example (min_val([4, 1, 3, 1]) == 1)
  example (min_val([2]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => min_acc(h, t) }
}

  requires contains(xs, v)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs)))
  ensures (xs[result] == v)
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != v)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 1, 3, 1], 1) == 1)
  example (index_of([2], 2) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, v)) }
}

  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take_front([1, 2, 3], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take_front([1, 2, 3], 0) == [])
  example (take_front([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take_front(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn drop_front(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop_front([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop_front([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
  example (drop_front([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match k { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop_front(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn max_of(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (x <= result)
  effects pure
  example (max_of([3, 9, 1]) == 9)
  example (max_of([4]) == 4)
  example (max_of([2, 7, 5]) == 7)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => h [_, ..r] => if (h > max_of(t)) then h else max_of(t) } }
}

fn below(xs: List[Int], m: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires forall x in xs: (x <= m)
  ensures forall x in result: (x < m)
  ensures forall x in xs: ((x == m) or contains(result, x))
  effects pure
  example (below([3, 9, 1], 9) == [3, 1])
  example (below([4], 4) == [])
  example (below([], 5) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h < m) then ([h] ++ below(t, m)) else below(t, m) }
}

fn second_largest(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((result == None) == (len(xs) < 2))
  ensures ((result == None) or (exists x in xs: (((result == Some(x)) and (x < max_of(xs))) and (forall y in xs: ((y == max_of(xs)) or (y <= x))))))
  effects pure
  example (second_largest([3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest([4]) == None)
  example (second_largest([]) == None)
  example (second_largest([10, 20, 30, 5]) == Some(20))
  example (second_largest([5, 2]) == Some(2))
{
  match xs { [] => None _ => match below(xs, max_of(xs)) { [] => None s => Some(max_of(s)) } }
}
